clients.title: Clients
clients.text: Organizations you serve. You see account details only, never their business data.
clients.empty_text: Client organizations you sign up will appear here.
clients.create_text: A client account with its first company. The company starts with its sector package; the owner can sign in right away.
clients.name: Client name
clients.name_required: Enter the client name in English.
clients.owner_hint: An existing account is added as owner; someone new is invited by email.
clients.country_hint: Brings the client's language, timezone, currency, week and weekend.
clients.suspend_text: Nobody in this client account can sign in until you reactivate it. No data is deleted.
clients.reactivate_text: Its members can sign in again.
clients.owner_name_hint: Needed only if the owner has no account yet.

rules.title: Partner rules
rules.text: Defaults for all your clients. Clients can adjust them unless you lock them.

limits.title: Limits of {name}
limits.text: A deal for this client only. Leave a field empty to follow the plan.
limits.read_only: Only partner owners and billing staff can change limits.

brand.title: Brand
brand.text: How the app looks for your clients: name, colors, images and texts. Changes show right away, no new version needed.
brand.product_name_hint: Shown in the browser tab, sign-in page and emails.
brand.contrast_text: Text on this color is hard to read. Choose a stronger color.
brand.contrast_surface: Too light to see on a white page. Choose a darker color.
brand.image_hint: PNG, WebP or JPEG, up to 512 KB.
brand.read_only: Only partner owners can change the brand.
brand.bands_hint: Thin strips of your brand colors under the header and the sidebar's brand row, like the colors of your logo. Leave empty for none.
brand.band_colors_hint: Up to four colors, side by side.
brand.side_band_color_hint: One color under the sidebar's brand row, level with the header band.

domains.title: Domains
domains.text: Your own web addresses. A domain works only after you prove you own it with a DNS record.
domains.host_hint: For example erp.yourcompany.com. Point it to this server first.
domains.client_hint: Leave empty for your own address (all clients).
domains.empty_text: Add an address such as erp.yourcompany.com so clients see only your brand.
domains.record_title: Add this DNS record, then check
domains.remove_text: The address stops opening your app right away.
domains.read_only: Only partner owners can manage domains.

modules.title: Modules for all clients
modules.text: Turn a module on or off for every client. Unlocked it is a default each client can change; locked, it decides for everyone.
modules.confirm_text: This applies to every client account right away.
modules.read_only: Only partner owners can change modules for all clients.

api.title: API keys
api.text: Let your own systems (website, CRM) create clients, add people and change plans. Account data only; never a client’s business data.
api.new_text: Choose what the key may do. It works in your name, until it expires or you revoke it.
api.name: Name
api.name_hint: What the key is for, e.g. "Website sign-up".

scope.clients_write: create clients (owners are invited by email)

api.once: Copy this key now and keep it safe. It is shown only once.
api.revoke_text: Systems using this key stop working at once.
api.empty_text: Create a key to connect your website or CRM.
api.how_text: Send the key as a bearer token. Up to {rate} requests per minute per key.
api.idempotency: Send an Idempotency-Key header with each create: if you retry, nothing is created twice.
